mobile.settings.theme.caption_forced.note: Caption under the mode control while it is forced to one side. {name} is a theme NAME (proper noun, never translated). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.caption_system.note: Caption under the mode control while it follows the phone. {light} and {dark} are theme NAMES (proper nouns such as "Dracula", never translated). Says which theme shows in each phone mode. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.card_dark.note: Screen-reader name of a theme card that is not selected. {name} is the theme NAME (proper noun, never translated). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.card_dark_selected.note: Screen-reader name of the SELECTED dark theme card. {name} is the theme NAME (never translated). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.card_light.note: Screen-reader name of a light theme card that is not selected. {name} is the theme NAME (never translated). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.card_light_selecte.note: Screen-reader name of the SELECTED light theme card. {name} is the theme NAME (never translated). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.mode_dark.note: Option: always use the dark side (a dark theme). Keep short; it shares a row with two other options.

mobile.settings.theme.mode_label.note: Accessible name of the three-way control that chooses whether the app follows the phone's light/dark setting or forces one. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.mode_light.note: Option: always use the light side (a light theme). Keep short; it shares a row with two other options.

mobile.settings.theme.mode_system.note: Option: follow the phone's own light/dark setting. Keep short (one word if possible); it shares a row with two other options.

mobile.settings.theme.no_match.note: Shown in a section when the search matches no theme in it. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.row_label.note: Screen-reader name of the Settings row that opens the Theme screen; {name} is the theme painting the app now (a proper noun, never translated). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.search_label.note: Accessible name of the search field that filters the theme list by name. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.search_placeholder.note: Placeholder inside the same search field. Usually identical to the field's accessible name. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.section_dark.note: Section heading over the grid of dark themes. {count} is how many dark themes the section currently lists (after search). Rendered in uppercase in some scripts. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.section_light.note: Section heading over the grid of light themes. {count} is how many light themes the section currently lists (after search). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.title.note: Title of the Theme screen and the label of the Settings row that opens it. "Theme" means a colour scheme for the whole app. No final full stop.
